meaningKo: 열심히 일을 시작하다; 마음을 다잡고 집중하다
exampleEn: It's time to dig in and finish this project.
exampleKo: 이제 일을 열심히 시작하고 이 프로젝트를 끝내야 할 때야.
gameExamples: Before the exam, I need to dig in and study for several hours.
The chef asked us to dig in as soon as the food was served at the dinner party.
With the deadline approaching, the team decided to dig in and make things happen.
